intent: A small, characterful status language for AI agents: eight animated 9×9 dot-matrix glyphs that read at 16px inline and still look crafted at 96px. Pixel art with discipline: one colour per state, a faint unlit grid and 10fps motion.

stack.rendering: inline SVG rects; no canvas, no dependencies
stack.animation: setInterval at 10fps driving a frame counter; each glyph is a pure function of the frame; motion/react for the gallery's text swaps

layout.glyph: 9×9 grid in a 90×90 viewBox; dots 7.6 units (8.4 under 28px) with radius 1.8 (1.2 small); unlit dots at currentColor 7% when grid=true; a blurred copy of lit cells at 55% for glow at 40px and up
layout.gallery: card #0b0b0c, radius 22px; header with eyebrow, title and a live inline run pill; 4×2 grid of tiles (2×4 in narrow containers) separated by 1px gaps, each with a 96px glyph, name, colour dot, note and a mono state attribute

color.rule: warm tones for work in progress, semantic colours only for outcomes; lit opacity 25% + 75% × intensity

motion.thinking: a comet with a 5-step tail circles a 16-cell square around a dim core
motion.searching: a magnifier drifts on a 1-pixel square loop every 6 frames while a glint crosses the lens
motion.writing: three lines type out left to right with a block cursor blinking every 4 frames, then hold and restart
motion.listening: four mirrored bars move on combined sine waves like a voice waveform
motion.syncing: two 6-cell arcs chase each other round a 16-cell ring
motion.done: the check draws one pixel per frame, a ring flashes once, then it holds (never loops)
motion.error: the exclamation shakes ±1px for 6 frames every 3 seconds
motion.idle: a 4×4 z rises and fades over 2.2s, then rests
motion.clock: 10fps, paused offscreen (IntersectionObserver) and in hidden tabs
motion.gallery: tiles are buttons: hover/focus replays the glyph, scales it 1.04 and draws a state-colour hairline; click copies the snippet with a sliding 'Copied snippet' confirmation; press scales 0.985
motion.run: run steps cross-fade with a 10px slide and 3px blur

responsive.sizes: works from 14px to 128px; under 28px dots grow slightly and the glow is dropped so it stays crisp
responsive.gallery: container queries: 2 columns by default, 4 from @2xl; the run pill sits under the title in narrow containers

accessibility: each glyph is role=img with a label (Thinking, Searching, … Needs attention)
the inline run row is aria-live=polite
colour is paired with a shape and a text label
avoid: more than one colour inside a glyph
smooth tweening that breaks the pixel feel
